title: The Cutting Edge: Week of August 16th
body:
**Highlights**
- Edgeware Community contributor [Richard Welsh talked about Edgeware and Kabocha](https://youtu.be/ZRSn6rBrPgE?t=733) spotlighting the gifting culture on ‘The Defiant’ youtube channel.
- Introducing the [white-labelled governance portal](https://gov.edgewa.re/) powered by Commonwealth aka Common Protocol (one of the Edgeware treasury funded projects). Existing forum with an easier way to navigate!
- [Edgscan aka explorer for Beresheet(testnet) EVM](https://beresheet.edgscan.com/) hosted by the PicoSwap team is now publicly available. Mainnet support will be added after the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade merges to the mainnet.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [PicoSwap is now live](https://pico.exchange/) on testnet(Beresheet).
- Dillon Chen from Commonwealth Labs will be speaking in ‘[Polkadot Web 3.0 Talks](https://twitter.com/Polkadot/status/1427236338420572165?s=20)’ about DAOs and Decentralized Governance on August 31, 2021.
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Common Protocol partners with [Marlin Protocol](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1428781510048587777?s=20).


**Governance**
- Recently passed proposal: Web3.0 DAO and NFT launchpad on Edgeware by New-Futures powered by RMRK. [Referendum 48]


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
